## Thanks for contributing

External contributions are welcome via **fork + pull request**. Direct pushes to `main` are blocked.

### Workflow

1. **Fork** [Boobuh/cursor-apollo-sandbox](https://github.com/Boobuh/cursor-apollo-sandbox)
2. **Branch** from `main` (`feature/my-change`, `fix/issue-123`, etc.)
3. **Commit** with clear messages (`fix: …`, `feat: …`, `chore: …`)
4. **Open a pull request** against `main`
5. **Wait for review** — [@Boobuh](https://github.com/Boobuh) (code owner) must approve before merge

### Before you open a PR

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm test
npm run test:coverage   # optional but appreciated
```

### Review policy

- All changes to `main` go through a pull request
- At least **one approval** from the code owner is required
- Only maintainers merge approved PRs (contributors do not need merge rights)

### Questions

Open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/Boobuh/cursor-apollo-sandbox/issues) or comment on your PR.
